shortDescription: Tokenized gold in on-chain RWA markets has reached $5.1 billion, accounting for 11% of the sector. According to ChainCatcher, XAUT represents $2.7 billion of that total, followed by PAXG at $1.9 billion, KAU at $230.8 million, PGOLD at $85.1 million, and XAUM at $66.1 million.
